6:45.text: So the people that committed wrong were eliminated. And praise to Allāh, Lord of the worlds.

6:47.text: Say, "Have you considered: if the punishment of Allāh should come to you unexpectedly or manifestly,
will any be destroyed but the wrongdoing people?"

6:48.text: And We send not the messengers except as bringers of good tidings and warners. So whoever believes and reforms - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
